title_en: Application for Approval of Courses Taken in Other Departments and Undergraduate Courses, Fall Semester 2026
summary: Graduate students who wish to have graduate courses offered by other departments, or undergraduate courses, recognised as credits toward completion must submit the attached application form, stamped by their academic advisor, to Room 319 between 3 and 17 September 2026. The notice also sets out the credit limits and the scope of recognition.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have graduate courses offered by departments other than the School of Electrical and Information Engineering (전기정보공학부), or undergraduate courses (학사과정 교과목), recognised as credits toward completion of their programme. Only courses similar to those of the School, offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (physics, mathematics, etc.), may be applied for. In principle, forms are for courses registered in the current semester. A student who did not submit a form for a course taken in a previous semester may submit one late with the academic advisor's approval.

dates.what: Individual email notification to students whose credit recognition is judged difficult after internal review
dates.when: Before the course drop deadline (the date is not stated in the notice)

steps: Download the relevant application form attached to the original notice: the Application for Approval of Courses in Other Departments (타학과 교과목 이수 승인신청서) and/or the Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses (학사과정 교과목 이수 승인신청서).
Complete the form and obtain your academic advisor's seal (지도교수 날인).
If the form is for a course taken in a previous semester for which you did not submit a form, obtain your academic advisor's approval and write "사후신청" (late application) at the top left of the form.
Submit the completed form to the staff member in charge in Room 319 between 3 September 2026 and 17 September 2026.
Check your official SNU email account. If the internal review finds that the credits are unlikely to be recognised, you will be notified individually before the course drop deadline.
translation:
Application for Approval of Courses Taken in Other Departments and Undergraduate Courses, Fall Semester 2026

★ Key Points
- Submission period: Thursday, 3 September 2026 to Thursday, 17 September 2026 (2026. 9. 3.(목) ~ 2026. 9. 17.(목))
- Submission method: Complete the attached application form, including your academic advisor's seal (지도교수 날인), and submit it to the staff member in charge in Room 319.
※ After internal review, if it is judged that the credits are unlikely to be recognised as credits toward completion, the student concerned will be notified individually by official SNU email before the course drop deadline (수강신청 취소기한).

★ Application for Approval of Courses in Other Departments (타학과 교과목 이수 승인신청서)
1) Submit this form if you are a graduate student and wish to have a graduate course offered by a department other than the School of Electrical and Information Engineering (전기정보공학부) recognised as credits toward completion.

2) Recognisable credits
- Only courses offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (physics, mathematics, etc.) that are similar to courses of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering may be applied for. Unrelated courses (e.g. physical education, arts, social sciences) are not recognised, but they are still included in the grade point average.
- For students admitted in 2020 or earlier: courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined may be recognised as credits toward completion only up to one half of the credits required for completion of the programme (과정별 수료학점).
- For students admitted in 2021 or later: courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined may be recognised only up to (credits required for completion of the programme − Thesis Research (논문연구) credits) × 1/2.
 * However, the number of credits from graduate courses of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering (excluding Thesis Research) must be greater than the number of credits from courses in other departments and undergraduate courses.
 ※ Example: For a master's programme, the credits required for completion are 24. If a student has taken 6 credits of graduate Thesis Research, then courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined are recognised only up to 9 credits, and the student must complete at least 9 credits in the major.
- Reference: Link (Related Notice 1), Link (Related Notice 2). [The linked notices were not included in the text and have not been read.]

3) Scope of recognition
- Not recognised toward the requirement for the thesis submission qualification examination (논문제출자격시험) (6 credits in the major). Not recognised as graduate course credits of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering upon completion.
- Recognised as general credits toward completion. Included in the grade point average.

3) Notes
- In principle, a form must be submitted for courses registered in the current semester. However, if you did not submit a form for a course taken in a previous semester, you may submit an additional form with your academic advisor's approval. In this case, you must write "사후신청" (late application) at the top left of the form.

★ Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses (학사과정 교과목 이수 승인신청서) (formerly the Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses, 학부과목 이수 승인신청서)
1) Submit this form if you are a graduate student and wish to have undergraduate courses recognised as credits toward completion.

2) Recognisable credits
- Up to 6 credits may be recognised in total across all of your graduate studies.
 ※ Example: If a doctoral student had 6 credits of undergraduate courses recognised as graduate completion credits during the master's programme, no undergraduate courses can be recognised as completion credits during the doctoral programme.
- Only courses offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (physics, mathematics, etc.) that are similar to courses of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering may be applied for. Unrelated courses (e.g. physical education, arts, social sciences) are not recognised, but they are still included in the grade point average.
- For students admitted in 2020 or earlier: courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined may be recognised as credits toward completion only up to one half of the credits required for completion of the programme.
- For students admitted in 2021 or later: courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined may be recognised only up to (credits required for completion of the programme − Thesis Research credits) × 1/2.
 * However, the number of credits from graduate courses of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering (excluding Thesis Research) must be greater than the number of credits from courses in other departments and undergraduate courses.
 ※ Example: For a master's programme, the credits required for completion are 24. If a student has taken 6 credits of graduate Thesis Research, then courses in other departments and undergraduate courses combined are recognised only up to 9 credits, and the student must complete at least 9 credits in the major.
- Reference: Link (Related Notice 1), Link (Related Notice 2). [The linked notices were not included in the text and have not been read.]

(Reference)
- Attachments: Application for Approval of Courses in Other Departments, Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses
- Enquiries: the department office (School Administration Office, Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.
